entities.name: Gijsbert Karel van Hogendorp
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gijsbert Karel, Count van Hogendorp was a liberal conservative and liberal Dutch statesman. He was the brother of Dirk van Hogendorp the elder and the father of Dirk van Hogendorp the younger.
